verdict.rationale: Featurebase's marketing page explicitly claims one-click connection of third-party tools ('Connect Featurebase with your favorite tools in just a few clicks, with new integrations added constantly'), directly matching the story, but the evidence pack contains no list of specific integrations, no screenshots, or independent confirmation of the actual click-through setup experience. missing for 10: concrete list/names of supported third-party tools, hands-on or independent verification of the 'few clicks' setup flow, documentation detail on integration configuration.
